claim: Sit on the E side (seats on the right-hand side heading to Tokyo) for the Fuji view.
fix: Sit on the E side (the left-hand side heading to Tokyo, since Fuji lies north of the line) for the Fuji view.
source_quote: 富士山が見える座席は新大阪駅に向かって右側、席でいうとE席

claim: In late December the rice paddies are cut to brown stubble, and on a clear day the snow-capped cone of Fuji shows up on the right-hand side of the train.
fix: In late December the rice paddies are cut to brown stubble, and on a clear day the snow-capped cone of Fuji shows up on the left-hand side of the train (the E-seat side) heading to Tokyo.
source_quote: 富士山がそびえるのは、その線路の北側です。
